title: On-Call Incident Responder Agent Answer
description: Standardized schema for the structured response block returned by the autonomous on-call coding agent.

root_cause.description: One sentence describing the identified defect root cause, or n/a for test alerts

fix.description: Files modified and summary of changes applied, or none

tests.description: Test command executed and resulting test status, or not run

summary.description: One concise standalone sentence for on-call audit log

last_line.description: The exact final SUMMARY line of the agent's answer
